newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ hires investment chief from BZW.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ hires investment chief from BZW.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Monday it had hired John Sunderland to head its investment banking activities globally.
Sunderland would join ANZ in November from BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays Bank Plc, ANZ said.
ANZ said it had drawn together in one unit the various business activities undertaken in support of its corporate and insitutional customer base across the world.
This included ANZ Financial markets, Equities, Global Structured Finance and Relationship Management activities.
